question: Where was the 24th and the last Tirthankara of Jainism, Vardhamana Mahavira born in 6th century BC?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Mahavira was the 24th Tirthankara of Jainism.
 
• Vardhamana__ is the original name of Lord Mahavira.
 
• He was born in 540 BCE in Kundagrama near **Vaishali in Bihar.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

 
• Vardhamana was a Kshatriya prince of the Lichchhavis.
 
• He left home and went to live in a forest at the age of 30.
 
• Followers of Mahavira, who were known as Jainas.
 
• The language used by Mahavira and his followers was the Prakrit language.
 
• He died in **468 BCE** at Pawapuri.
